description: Use the jobId of a Doctor consult already started after the customer accepted its quote. Send a planned fact, public subject names, league, date, timezone and optional eventId. While the consult is running, this can join and run its metered planned lookup; after it succeeds, it returns the saved outcome, reason and linked sources. If the fields do not match, lookup_not_planned can include extra.plannedLookups: the exact allowed {fact, subject, league, date, timezone, eventId} fields. Retry with one of those entries and the same jobId. If the plan is not ready yet, retry after the consult has planned it. Use the quoted sources for facts and numbers.
name: look_up_fact
title: Look up a Doctor fact
